title: AI Animal Video Maker: Cast Animals in Any Scene
summary: Make AI animal videos with real prompts from Flick films: crows, a hound, rabbits. Keep one animal steady across shots and make it move like the real thing.
body_markdown:
### What is an AI animal video generator?


An AI animal video generator is a tool that makes a video clip of an animal from a text prompt, a photo or both. Flick is built for films, so the same animal can be cast across many shots on one canvas, with a reference sheet keeping it the same.


### Can I make an AI animal video for free?


Yes, you can start free: you get 100 credits when you sign up, 200 more for joining the Flick Discord, and 100 credits every week. The free plan includes MiniMax H3 Max video, while Seedance 2.0 and Seedance 2.5 need the Standard plan ($20 a month).


### Can I turn a photo of my pet into a video?


Yes. Upload the photo to a Flick canvas and use it as the start frame of an image to video clip, or make a reference sheet of your pet from it first and cite that sheet in every shot so it stays the same.


### How do I keep the same animal in every shot?


Make one reference sheet of the animal, with front and side views on a plain background, and cite it in every prompt that shows it. The hound in the residency film Catch Out was kept steady this way, with his sheet cited in 15 of the film's 29 clips.


### How do I make an AI animal move like a real one?


Describe its small natural movements, such as head turns, posture shifts and feather or fur movement, then list what it must not do, such as flying away, calling or anything theatrical. Writing both halves keeps the model from turning the animal into a cartoon.


### Can I make cartoon or hand-drawn animal videos?


Yes. Put the style first in the prompt, for example hand-drawn 2D animation on twos with painted backgrounds, and cite a drawn reference of the animal. The rabbit in Duro, a 2D film from the Flick residency, was made this way with Seedance 2.5.


### Which AI video models can I use for animal videos in Flick?


Flick runs Seedance 2.0, Seedance 2.5, Kling 3.0 Pro, Veo 3.1 and MiniMax H3 on the Standard plan, and MiniMax H3 Max, MiniMax H3 Fast and Pruna Draft on the free plan. You can mix models across shots of the same film.
